wrong_claims: 'standard Promotion object has no end date or status picklist' (reported by AskCoworker): describe shows standard Promotion has EndDateTime (datetime) and IsActive (boolean). The 'no status picklist' part is true, but 'no end date' is wrong. The run used this to reject a candidate without a one-line describe check. The conclusion still holds, because standard Promotion has 0 records and Promotion__c is the clear target.

defects.defect: An AskCoworker claim used to reject the standard Promotion object was left unverified, although a describe (an allowed command) would have shown EndDateTime/IsActive. It was labelled 'reported by AskCoworker', so this is not dishonest, but it is verifiable and partly wrong.
defects.skill_gap: The skill should require verifying, with an allowed query, any AskCoworker claim that rejects a reuse candidate when a describe can check it.

defects.defect: Open 1 (external customer-facing reader) is marked 'blocking for delivery' even though the inventory does not depend on it. That overstates the blocking status.
defects.skill_gap: The run's friction note flags the conflict between 'undeliverable responsibility: mark blocking' and the case where the inventory does not depend on it. SKILL.md has no tie-break.
